note: WEAPONDROP v1 (WeaponDrop.cs). The weapon of a dead fighter leaves the hand delayS after the kill and falls as a real body (compound collider, mass, centre of mass), rests, loses its body, stays or is collected with the loot. One row per roster character (and optional weapon id); no row, enabled false or no file = today. Units: metres, seconds, kg, rad/s. Presentation only: the sim never reads it.

shapes.note: Pitborn's maul_start glb (mesh bounds y -0.30..0.70): shaft radius 0.04 up to y 0.30, head box y 0.30..0.70 (0.52 x 0.40 x 0.48), numbers from lanePHYSWEAPON section 3. headFrom 0.6 = 0.30 of the 1.0 m. headShrink 0.95 keeps the box inside the mesh so it does not float.
sword_start glb (blade to y 0.996, guard 0.16 wide): one box, narrowed to the blade across and thin in depth. UNVERIFIED, no armed sword enemy in the build today.
fallback for a weapon without a shape: one box of the mesh bounds
